CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

2. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   C. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.

11. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)

   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.

   D. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

14. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

15. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
